item: the engine identity carries a hand-bumped INDEXER_VERSION and the code digest polices it
summary: R412 amends R24: the engine id (restore carry and backlog skip) no longer hashes the bytes of the engine files; it carries INDEXER_VERSION, bumped by hand when the rows index_article writes change. code_digest() stays as the police: configs/indexer_pin.json records its value at the last judgement and tests/test_indexer_pin.py is red whenever the files moved without a recorded judgement. scripts/indexer_pin.py --bump WHAT or --same WHY is the only way back to green and refuses a missing sentence; the sentence is logged in the pin and repeated in the PR. Effect: builds that differ only in changes recorded --same keep the same engine id, so a backup from the previous build still carries its derived rows (R24 carry measured 8x on an encrypted store, 18-19x plaintext). One-time re-extract after the upgrade (identity schema oo-index-engine-2). Data files (stoplists, rings, gazetteers incl. the per-install configs/cities.yml and configs/places_gazetteer.yml) stay hashed at runtime and are the identity, so only code needs a judgement; line endings are normalised. Stated limit: a --same recorded for a change that did alter the output carries stale rows; the sentence and the review are the only defence.
